title: Composition of explicit raw cohomology pullbacks
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $k:W\to S$ a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $W$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $U\to S$ etale. Use the raw groups $P_A(U)$ and their explicit five-factor maps $r_f$ of [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-naturality]. For every $f:A\to B$ and $g:B\to C$ in the category of schemes over $W$, and every $z\in P_C(U)$, one has $r_{f\gg g}(z)=r_f(r_g(z))$. This statement only asserts composition; it assumes no functoriality of the raw groups and imposes no limit or quasi-compactness conditions.

theorem higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_comp
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {A B C : Over W} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q C).obj (op U)) :
    higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q (f ≫ g) U z =
      higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U
        (higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q g U z)
